sin.name: viewer-timer-by-hand
sin.description: A viewer file starts its own timer to read or to tick, with setInterval or with a setTimeout that awaits a read and schedules itself again, so what an event or the one clock could do becomes another request or another clock.
sin.rule: Follow an event with context.follow, read the shared clock with useNow or useSharedNow, or read on an interval with usePoll. A timer is added to this rule's list only for what no event announces. usePoll is the one poll built on setTimeout, and is left out.
